title: Gitignore pipeline runtime artifact directories
problem: Pipeline artifact directories (specs/, plans/, executions/, hardens/, reports/) are tracked in git, causing artifact loss when the orchestrator switches between feature branches and master during resume after failure. Docs already describe these as git-ignored but .gitignore does not reflect that.
description:
Pipeline orchestrator artifact loss on resume across branch switches.

When the pipeline runs the executor, it creates a feature branch (pipeline/<uuid>) and commits step changes there. The auto_harden stage also commits fix rounds to that branch. If the harden process touches tracked pipeline artifacts (specs/, plans/, executions/), those become committed only on the feature branch.

When approval merges the feature branch back to master, that's fine for a fresh end-to-end run. But if a stage fails and the pipeline is later resumed, the orchestrator may switch back to master to find tracked artifacts missing (they only exist on the feature branch).

Reproduced on ticket ead3d93f: harden's round 1 fix commit included pipeline/specs/<uuid>.json. After harden passed, the approval stage on master couldn't find spec/plan/execution files because they were branch-only. Manual fix: git checkout <branch> -- pipeline/specs/<uuid>.json pipeline/plans/<uuid>.json pipeline/executions/<uuid>.json, then commit them to master before re-running approval.

Possible fixes:
1. Gitignore pipeline/specs/, pipeline/plans/, pipeline/executions/, pipeline/hardens/, pipeline/reports/ — they're regenerable artifacts, not source. Only intake/ should be tracked.
2. Have run.py auto-restore missing tracked artifacts from the pipeline branch on resume.
3. Have auto_harden refuse to commit anything in pipeline/specs|plans|executions paths so the artifacts stay on master only.

Option 1 is the cleanest — these are runtime artifacts and should not be in git history. Note that file-storage.md docs already describe these as 'git-ignored except pipeline/intake/' but the .gitignore doesn't actually exclude them.
scope: Modify .gitignore to exclude pipeline/specs/, pipeline/plans/, pipeline/executions/, pipeline/hardens/, pipeline/reports/. Remove these directories from git tracking via git rm --cached. Verify pipeline/intake/ and pipeline/backlog/ remain tracked.
